Description: A media-director run is judged against its SKILL contract: read the guide and the provider menu before choosing anything, write both the human direction and the version 1 execution spec under media/specs/ with a complete governance block, hand off, and never render ahead of sign-off.

Criteria.Name: Dispatch behaved as declared
Criteria.Statement: The run did not behave the way the fixture declares, so nothing downstream of it can be trusted.

Criteria.Name: Read the guide and the provider menu first
Criteria.Statement: A provider was chosen without reading AGENT_GUIDE.md or running provider_menu_summary().

Criteria.Name: Wrote both spec artifacts under media/specs/
Criteria.Statement: SKILL.md steps 6 and 7 require both media/specs/<ticket-id>.md and media/specs/<ticket-id>.json; a direction without a machine spec is not executable.

Criteria.Name: Execution spec is version 1 with a complete governance block
Criteria.Statement: The governance block is what the downstream render gate reads; a spec without it cannot be gated on.

Criteria.Name: Held the render gate
Criteria.Statement: Frames were produced before the storyboard was signed off.

Criteria.Name: Emitted the handoff comment
Criteria.Statement: The dependent worker is dispatched off the handoff; without it the next hop re-derives the spec from the ticket.
